description: Source file defining the NoteRepository class that provides an API for managing notes, backed by SQLite storage, including methods for observing, adding, updating, and deleting notes.

classes.name: NoteRepository
classes.description: Repository class providing data management for notes with coroutine support and singleton pattern.

methods.name: observeNotes
methods.description: Returns a LiveData list of notes that updates asynchronously.

methods.name: getNote
methods.description: Retrieves a single note by its ID, suspending until result is available.

methods.name: addNote
methods.description: Adds a new note with the provided title and content, returning its assigned ID.

methods.name: updateNote
methods.description: Updates an existing note identified by ID with new title and content.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Deletes a note by its ID.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refetches all notes and updates the LiveData.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Singleton accessor for the NoteRepository instance.
